D5/S3/Arith/RepeatingDecimal/RepeatingDe.name: D5.S3.Arith.RepeatingDecimal.RepeatingDecimalQuotient.long_division_invariant
D5/S3/Arith/RepeatingDecimal/RepeatingDe.signature: theorem long_division_invariant (b p q n : ℕ) : q * longDivisionPrefix b p q n + remainder b p q n = b ^ n * p

D5/S3/Arith/RepeatingDecimal/RepeatingDe.name: D5.S3.Arith.RepeatingDecimal.RepeatingDecimalQuotient.long_division_period
D5/S3/Arith/RepeatingDecimal/RepeatingDe.signature: theorem long_division_period {b p q : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hp : p < q) (L : ℕ) (hL : q ∣ b ^ L - 1) : Function.Periodic (digit b p q) L ∧ ((b : ℝ) ^ L - 1) * ((p : ℝ) / q) = (longDivisionPrefix b p q L : ℝ)

D5/S3/Arith/RepeatingDecimal/RepeatingDe.name: D5.S3.Arith.RepeatingDecimal.RepeatingDecimalQuotient.long_division_value
D5/S3/Arith/RepeatingDecimal/RepeatingDe.signature: theorem long_division_value {b p q : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hp : p < q) : HasSum (fun n => (digit b p q n : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)) ((p : ℝ) / q) ∧ Tendsto (fun n => (longDivisionPrefix b p q n : ℝ) / (b : ℝ) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 ((p : ℝ) / q))
